preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 10^5) representing the number of operations.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == 1 or (len(line.split()) - 1) % 2 == 0 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each of the next n lines starts with an integer k (0 ≤ k ≤ i-1 for the i-th operation), followed by 2k integers (v_j, x_j) where 1 ≤ v_j ≤ i-1 and |x_j| ≤ 10^9.
The sum of all k values across operations does not exceed 10^5.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum_of_edge_weights % 1000000007) and sum_of_edge_weights == sum(edge_weight for edge_weight in edge_weights)
postconditions.description: The output is a single integer representing the sum of all edge weights in the resulting forest modulo 1000000007, where edge_weights is the list of all edge weights added during the operations.

postconditions.expression: all(edge_weight == depth(v_j) + x_j for (v_j, x_j, _) in edges if edge_weight is defined) and all(1 <= v_j <= i-1 for (v_j, x_j, i) in edges)
postconditions.description: For each edge added in operation i, the weight is computed as depth(v_j) + x_j, where depth(v_j) is the depth of vertex v_j at the time of the operation, and v_j is a vertex added in a previous operation.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n+1)) and all(1 <= v_j <= i-1 for (v_j, x_j, i) in edges)
postconditions.description: Vertices are numbered sequentially from 1 to n, and each edge connects a root of an existing vertex v_j to a newly added vertex i.
